items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Phineas was my J.S. Bach, because he came and saw what was happenin’ and took me early on, you know, to a teacher.

ctx.x: Well as I was mentioning to you, Memphis is something that is deep in my heart also, but this is about you.
His mother went to Booker Washington, where Phineas went.
Yeah, they were two years apart Dorothy Darr: Wow.
